ledger.x: c. 1200: Manco Capac founds the Kingdom of Cusco. Infobox 'Manco Capac organized the Kingdom of Cusco: c. 1200'; 'began as a small city-state founded by the Incas around the start of 13th century'. The migration legend from Lake Titicaca and Pacaritambo is undated.

c. 1350: the Hanan Cusco line takes the throne. 'Inca Roca became the first Hanan Cusco ruler' around c. 1350 after overthrowing Capac Yupanqui with Hanan Cusco support; the page calls the Hurin dynasty a rival line and dates no division. Same state, colour continues.
Viracocha Inca invades the Yucay and Calca valleys.
ledger.cp: Yucay and Calca valley groups (unnamed on the page)

ledger.x: c. 1438: the Chanka war transforms the kingdom. The war's date is uncertain ('The exact date of the conflict is unknown'; Rowe 1438, del Busto 1424-25, Dammert 1430-1440); the infobox gives 'Inca victory; Establishment of the Inca Empire' and the Chanka confederation is annexed. The Cusco shape passes to the Inca…

c. 1438: the Kingdom of Cusco becomes the Inca Empire. 'The Inca Empire 1438-1533' (lead); Viracocha Inca ruled to c. 1438 and Cusi Yupanqui (Pachacuti) defeated the Chanka c. 1438. The land goes whole to the Inca Empire.

wars.name: Chanka-Inca War
wars.outcome: Inca victory under Cusi Yupanqui (Pachacuti); the Chanka army 'entire army annihilated' (infobox); establishment of the Inca Empire and annexation of the Chanka confederation.

certainty.note: No border is described by any page; the shape is Cliopatria's approximation of the Cusco valley.
